paper_metadata.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
paper_metadata.abstract: In this work, we develop and release Llama 2, a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned large language models (LLMs) ranging in scale from 7 billion to 70 billion parameters. Our fine-tuned LLMs, called Llama 2-Chat, are optimized for dialogue use cases. Our models outperform open-source chat models on most benchmarks we tested, and based on our human evaluations for helpfulness and safety, may be a suitable substitute for closed-source models. We provide a detailed description of our approach to fine-tuning and safety improvements of Llama 2-Chat in order to enable the community to build on our work and contribute to the responsible development of LLMs.

extraction_data.innovation: Two-stage alignment pipeline: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on a small, carefully curated set of ~27.5k instruction examples, followed by Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) using two specialized reward models (Helpfulness RM and Safety RM) trained on over 1 million binary human preference comparisons to optimize for helpfulness and safety separately.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 2 trillion tokens of curated text data (web text, books, code, articles)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), RLHF with PPO; SFT with GhostAttention (GAtt) for Llama 2-Chat, Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for instruction following; RLHF for preference alignment.
extraction_data.extension: SFT on ~27.5k high-quality instruction annotations followed by RLHF with separate Helpfulness and Safety reward models trained on >1M human preference comparisons.
extraction_data.research_problem: Instruction following and human preference alignment.
extraction_data.application: Dialogue use cases, complex reasoning tasks, programming, creative writing, AI assistants
extraction_data.paper_title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Human preference data, safety data, SFT annotation data, human preference data for reward model training, Publicly available instruction tuning data, vendor-annotated high-quality SFT data (27,540 annotations), 27, 540 human-annotated instruction examples; >1M binary human preference comparisons (Meta reward modeling data)
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for 70B model, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Multi-head self-attention, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) with 8 KV projections
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training -> Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) -> Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Synthetic concatenation of system instructions to user messages for GAtt training data
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Reward model trained on human preferences, Whitened logit scores with KL penalty (beta=0.01 for 7B/13B, 0.005 for 34B/70B), Separate Helpfulness and Safety reward models trained on human preference data, Two separate reward models (Helpfulness RM and Safety RM) trained on >1M binary human preference comparisons with 4-point preference strength labels.
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Red teaming, human evaluations for helpfulness and safety
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Llama2-Chat 70B winrate 36% vs ChatGPT, tie rate 31.5%; TruthfulQA: 7B 29.13, 13B 41.74, 34B 43.45, 70B 50.18; ToxiGen: 7B 22.32, 13B 23.08, 34B 21.19, 70B 24.60; MMLU: 57.5; BBH: 4.9; AGIEval: 26.8; Math: 41.0; Code: 14.1; MMLU: 65.8; BBH: 10.9; AGIEval: 46.9; Math: 52.6; Code: 18.9; MMLU: 68.0; BBH: 24.2; AGIEval: 62.6; Math: 58.7; Code: 27.8; MMLU: 69.4; BBH: 35.2; AGIEval: 68.9; Math: 63.6; Code: 37.5; TriviaQA: 85.0; NaturalQuestions: 33.0; GSM8K: 56.8; HumanEval: 29.9; BIG-BenchHard: 51.2
